Permission was not granted. Manual tracking remains available.
HabitFlow requests only exercise-session read access. It does not write health records or upload your health information. You can revoke access in Health Connect settings at any time.

If you opt in, HabitFlow can read exercise sessions from Health Connect to support future walking, running, and cycling habit mappings. Health records stay on your device; HabitFlow will not upload them or change them. It never needs health access for manual habits. You control and can revoke permissions in Health Connect settings.
